raw_decisions.code_evidence: The candidate preserves the self-contained SmallResNet and validates every epoch using tune micro-F1 with tune-only threshold calibration before selecting the saved checkpoint.
The implementation records per-epoch loss, tune micro-F1, threshold, selected epoch, seed, optimizer, and preprocessing in meta.json.
The candidate uses lazy PIL decoding, a compact CNN, BCEWithLogitsLoss, global tune threshold search, argmax fallback, and no external assets.
The model is self-contained and uses dense two-dimensional N x 3474 labels without flattening the label matrix.
The residual architecture and tune-aligned validation are retained, while prevalence-aware output-bias initialization is added as the single measurable modeling modification.
The candidate bounds epochs by budget, handles short runs with a fallback checkpoint, saves explicit preprocessing metadata, and reloads the exact architecture and state in predict.
